martin-kibuthu.name: Martin Kibuthu
martin-kibuthu.bio: Martin founded Kahoa Coffee in Austin, Texas. He grew up picking coffee on his grandfather's farm in the Kenyan highlands, and he writes here about where our coffee comes from and how to enjoy it.
martin-kibuthu.image_alt: Martin Kibuthu, founder of Kahoa Coffee, smiling at a Kahoa festival booth
